label: C2 from B2 and B3 (inference)
rule: Instantiate B2 and B3 at each contingent being; second disjunct
meaning: A contingent being has a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse (B2), simply prior to it (B3): the second disjunct of C2. Shows that C2 is weaker than B2 (given B3); uncausedComposite shows it is strictly weaker.
